# Assumptions

Every diagnostic carries an `assumption` key (in the JSON and SARIF output and in `-report` rows): the assumption
about the ledger that the reported code makes. The key is stable, so a tool can map a diagnostic to a query for
the ledger inputs that violate it. A rule reports its default key unless a report names a more precise one.

| Key | Input that violates it | Default of |
|---|---|---|
| `address-kind:base-account` | an M… (muxed account), W… (muxed contract), B… (claimable balance) or L… (liquidity pool) address where a G… or C… address is expected | XDR102 |
| `depth:recursion` | an authorization tree or ScVal nested as deep as stellar-core admits | XDR201 |
| `depth:worklist` | a tree with as many nodes as stellar-core admits | XDR202 |
| `discarded-error:stored` | an input the called function rejects (a malformed strkey, a number that does not parse, an arm the value does not hold), so a zero value is stored | XDR403 |
| `enum-closed:default` | an xdr enum value the switch does not handle (one a later protocol adds, or one the code forgot) | XDR406 |
| `event-emitter:token` | a token-shaped event emitted by a contract that is not the asset's contract | XDR304 |
| `event-shape:topic-count` | a contract event with fewer topics than the code indexes (any contract can emit any number) |  |
| `event-shape:value-kind` | a contract event whose topic or data value has another ScVal type than the code assumes | XDR404 |
| `lcm-version:subset` | a LedgerCloseMeta of a version the code does not accept |  |
| `lcm-version:v0-only` | a LedgerCloseMeta that is not v0 (every ledger since protocol 20) |  |
| `lcm-version:v1-only` | a LedgerCloseMeta that is not v1 (v0 before protocol 20, v2 since protocol 23) |  |
| `lcm-version:v2-only` | a LedgerCloseMeta older than v2 (ledgers before protocol 23) |  |
| `limit:below-core` | an input between the code's bound and what stellar-core admits | XDR207 |
| `limit:overflow-policy` | an input at the bound the code enforces | XDR206 |
| `memo:not-an-id` | a payment with a text or hash memo to an account that is not muxed | XDR101 |
| `meta-version:subset` | a TransactionMeta of a version the code does not accept (v0–v3 from captive core or older history, or a version a later protocol adds) | XDR401 |
| `meta-version:v0-only` | a TransactionMeta that is not v0 |  |
| `meta-version:v1-only` | a TransactionMeta that is not v1 |  |
| `meta-version:v2-only` | a TransactionMeta that is not v2 |  |
| `meta-version:v3-only` | a TransactionMeta that is not v3 (v4 since protocol 23, v0–v2 in older history) |  |
| `meta-version:v4-only` | a TransactionMeta older than v4 (captive core, older datastores, history before protocol 23) |  |
| `narrowing:i128->float64` | a 128-bit amount above 2^53 raw units |  |
| `narrowing:i128->int64` | a 128-bit amount or balance ≥ 2^63 (SAC and custom token balances above 2^63 exist on mainnet) |  |
| `narrowing:i64->int32` | a 64-bit amount or count outside the int32 range |  |
| `narrowing:int->smaller` | an integer outside the range of the smaller type it is converted to |  |
| `narrowing:u32->int16` | a 32-bit value above 32,767 |  |
| `narrowing:u64->float64` | a 64-bit unsigned value above 2^53, which float64 cannot hold exactly |  |
| `narrowing:u64->int32` | a 64-bit unsigned value ≥ 2^31 |  |
| `narrowing:u64->int64` | a 64-bit unsigned value ≥ 2^63 (a muxed ID, a time bound) | XDR402 |
| `participant:auth-tree` | an authorization entry or invocation argument that names an account the transaction never touched | XDR301 |
| `participant:envelope-only` | an account touched only through meta (fee changes, entry changes, events) | XDR303 |
| `participant:failed-tx` | a failed transaction whose operations name accounts that were never touched | XDR302 |
| `phase:tx-changes-as-op` | a transaction whose fee or transaction-level changes (txChangesBefore/After) touch an entry, read as an effect of one operation |  |
| `size:decoded-length` | a decoded count or length as large as its type allows | XDR203 |
| `size:decoder-limits` | hostile XDR bytes with a huge length prefix or nesting | XDR205 |
| `size:serialised-value` | a recursive value whose serialisation is as long as stellar-core admits | XDR204 |
| `success-gate:diagnostic-events` | a failed Soroban transaction whose diagnostic events record token movements of calls that were rolled back | XDR405 |
| `suppression:reviewed` | none: XDR000 is about the suppression files, not about an input | XDR000 |
| `text-to-db:bytes` | a string or bytes value with invalid UTF-8 or a NUL byte (a memo, symbol, string or asset code chosen by a submitter or a contract) | XDR103 |
| `text-to-db:memo` | a text memo with invalid UTF-8 or a NUL byte |  |
| `union-arm:single` | a union value that holds another arm than the one the code reads | XDR105 |
